result.title: When is early stopping beneficial under label noise? A phase diagram for kernel gradient flow
result.summary: Early stopping is commonly used to prevent fitting label noise from degrading generalization. Does this mean that, when a positive fraction of the training labels is intrinsically unpredictable, the best test error must occur before interpolation? Experiments on a CIFAR10 classification task with randomly labeled examples motivate the opposite possibility: although fixed-feature and shallow models exhibit late-time deterioration of the test error, the need for early stopping essentially disappears in larger, deeper convolutional networks even after the random labels have all been classified correctly. We determine when late-time deterioration disappears entirely in a solvable setting. For kernel gradient flow on a synthetic noisy classification task, we derive sharp high-dimensional learning curves and obtain a phase diagram controlled by the balance between the linear kernel component that learns the shared relation between inputs and labels and the higher-order components that enable fitting the label noise. In one regime, generalization is optimized at finite time and early stopping is necessary. In another, generalization improves until interpolation, but the endpoint is suboptimal across kernels. At the boundary, the interpolating endpoint attains the lowest generalization error across the considered kernel family and all training times. Thus, even with extensive irreducible label noise, interpolation can outperform early stopping. The neural-network experiments leave open how learned representations acquire an analogous favorable geometry.

AI.brief_summary: 论文考察标签噪声下早停何时真正有益：在合成噪声分类任务上推导核梯度流的高维学习曲线，得到由线性核分量与高阶分量平衡所控制的相图，并用 CIFAR10 随机标签实验观察深卷积网络中早停需求是否消失。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「有限时间最优」「插值端点反而最优」的相区划分，可能为 LVR 中 STOP 决策的收益/成本与「继续计算到饱和是否划算」提供类比分析框架，但该文不含视觉推理状态，可供核查的是停止准则的可解模型而非 latent 机制。
